## How Delay Repay Works

**Delay Repay compensates you when you arrive at your destination later than scheduled, regardless of the cause of the delay.** You don't need to prove the operator was at fault. Compensation is based on the delay to your **arrival** at your final destination, not the departure delay.

## For a 47-Minute Delay

A 47-minute delay falls into the **30 to 59 minutes** band, which entitles you to **50% of the single fare you paid**.

## Minimum Delay

Yes, there is a minimum: **delays under 15 minutes do not qualify** for compensation.

## Full Compensation Bands

| Delay on arrival | Compensation |
|---|---|
| Under 15 minutes | No compensation |
| 15 to 29 minutes | 25% of single fare paid |
| 30 to 59 minutes | **50% of single fare paid** ← Your 47-minute delay |
| 60 to 119 minutes | 100% of single fare paid |
| 120 minutes or more | 100% of total fare paid (including return leg) |

**Important:** Compensation is calculated on the fare you actually paid, after any railcard discounts have been applied.

*(Source: delay-repay.md)*
